name: @corbits-builder/build-web-app-express
description: Builds a web app from an idea with nothing waiting on the person
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The person brings an idea for an app and wants it planned, designed and built.
builder.unless: The project already has an app, or the person wants only one piece of the work, such as a mockup.

input.title: User manual
input.instruction: Write a user manual for the app as built: what it is for, how to get started, each screen and task step by step in plain words, and answers to the questions a first-time user is likely to ask.

examples: I want to build a weather app
help me make an app for booking dog walks
